subject: Agent 01 final: Alpha3 authority validated; direct UID2000 sensor remains physical deletion gate
body: Final sync at 98a7c1cde9fd36d47562b40fa25ed0b094038e70. Alpha3 is landed/build-verified and now has service-owned Fold7AngleAuthority plus ordered hinge ingress. DuoShellService still has no direct SensorManager hinge listener; precise acquisition remains FoldInteractive/logcat. Current AOSP enforces a sensor required permission at enable against the Binder caller, while adb-backed Shizuku UserService is UID 2000. No inspectable raw Fold7 UID-2000 receipt for private 65686/65695 exists in the room, so the peer denial remains strong but not independently DEV-confirmed. Recommendation: keep FoldInteractive as precise producer and run the published UID-2000 direct-sensor gate. If it passes, replace only the producer and preserve Alpha3 authority/session/order semantics; if denied/root-only/coarse/stale, close the direct SensorManager branch.
